geometry: Semelle et dalle rectangulaires superposees, marche arriere. Stele haute asymetrique a sommet courbe descendant vers la droite, cote droit arrondi et cote gauche cintre. Large bande sombre en croissant sur la gauche de la stele.
fixed_features: Contour asymetrique galbe de la stele
Bande/croissant sombre integre a la gauche de la stele
Base a niveaux et marche arriere
removable_accessories: Vase haut et cintre a l'avant gauche
material_zones: Pierre claire mouchetee pour base et grande partie de stele; bande gauche de stele et vase en pierre sombre.
ambiguity: La bande sombre de stele est une zone bicolore fixe, pas une ombre. La ligne fine claire au raccord est visible.
generation_note: Retirer vase et fleurs; conserver la bande bicolore fixe et son contour.
decisionPilote: La bande sombre de stele est une seconde pierre fixe, distincte d'une ombre. La pierre claire du corps principal varie. Vase et fleurs retires avec leurs reflets.

specificationGeneration.geometry: a compact cinerary monument with two stacked rectangular base slabs, a rear step, and an asymmetric curved headstone with a broad dark crescent integrated along its left side
specificationGeneration.stoneAreas: only the base slabs, rear step and broad main headstone field, which are light speckled stone in the source
specificationGeneration.fixedAreas: Keep the broad integrated left crescent of the headstone in its original dark polished stone, preserving its exact curved boundary and the fine light junction line.
specificationGeneration.extraConstraints: The dark crescent is a fixed structural stone zone, not a shadow or optional ornament. Do not remove it, widen it or recolor it with the selected main material.
specificationGeneration.masterDescription: Preserve the wider lower rectangular plinth, upper rectangular slab and rear supporting step. Keep the tall asymmetric headstone with a high left tip, top flowing down toward the right, rounded right side and curved left side. Preserve the broad dark crescent on its left as fixed secondary stone; the rest of the monument is the variable primary stone.
specificationGeneration.removeDescription: Remove the tall waisted dark vase, both roses, green foliage and all their reflections. Keep the underlying slab plain.
specificationGeneration.interpretationNote: La bande sombre de stele est une seconde pierre fixe, distincte d'une ombre. La pierre claire du corps principal varie. Vase et fleurs retires avec leurs reflets.
